span.p: challenge.pcapng — 966 packets, one keep-alive HTTP session

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
naive reassembly from the IP total-length field:
198 requests but 203 replies, five ~5,890-byte gaps
in the client stream. Looks like deliberate redaction.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
It isn't. Large send offload on the capturing host means
some frames are longer than their IP header claims.
Trust the captured frame length (allow 6 bytes of padding).

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
telemetry #2: feedback_length = 8208 = 0x2010, the key tag.
buffer[i] = machineGuid[i] XOR sessionId[15-i] —
and session_id is in the same JSON document.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
h = ((a>>2) + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15 + (a<<6) + b) ^ a
state = fmix64(h), the MurmurHash3 finalizer

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
per byte: state = state * 0x5851f42d4c957f2d
+ 0x14057b7ef767814f, keystream = state >> 56
(PCG's 64-bit LCG constants)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ciphertext, in capture order:
— two one-shot highscore rows marked cmd:
BANANA / 2066361377, BENIGN / 1932142625
— telemetry #4 and #5, length with bit 0x4000 set

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p:
the cipher state is global, so decrypt strictly in order:
command 1, output 1, command 2, output 2

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 560px; text-align: center;

span.p: cmd:cmd.exe;/c dir -> a listing containing flag.txt, 46 bytes
